story_zh: 礼拜天，我和孙子去北京旅行。导游带我们参观长城和京剧艺术。在热闹的餐厅，我们吃了著名的烤鸭、包子和饺子。汤的味道很香，但有点咸。小伙子演员很帅，他讲了一个幽默的笑话，让我们心情幸福。我们尊重中国的民族和文化，真正感受到了节日的快乐。干杯！
story_pinyin: Lǐbàitiān, wǒ hé sūnzi qù Běijīng lǚxíng. Dǎoyóu dài wǒmen cānguān Chángchéng hé Jīngjù yìshù. Zài rènào de cāntīng, wǒmen chīle zhùmíng de kǎoyā, bāozi hé jiǎozi. Tāng de wèidào hěn xiāng, dàn yǒudiǎn xián. Xiǎohuǒzi yǎnyuán hěn shuài, tā jiǎngle yīgè yōumò de xiàohuà, ràng wǒmen xīnqíng xìngfú. Wǒmen zūnzhòng Zhōngguó de mínzú hé wénhuà, zhēnzhèng gǎnshòu dàole jiérì de kuàilè. Gānbēi!
story_en: On Sunday, my grandson and I traveled to Beijing. The tour guide took us to visit the Great Wall and Peking Opera art. In a lively restaurant, we ate famous roast duck, steamed buns, and dumplings. The soup tasted fragrant but a bit salty. The young actor was handsome, and he told a humorous joke that made us feel happy. We respect China's ethnic groups and culture, truly experiencing the joy of the festival. Cheers!
